_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE deep neck / suboccipital volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_deep_neck_from_cryo.py), plus the mapping onto atlas entities. A KEY, not data. rule-based: markers by position rules relative to her vertebral labels, boundaries by marker watershed on the pale septa of her cryosection photographs; compartments are muscles the photographs do not separate (mapped to null).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female colour cryosections (1 mm frame) and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 `total`, `headneck_muscles`, `headneck_bones_vessels` labels as anchors. Rules from Standring S (ed.), Gray's Anatomy, 42nd ed., ch. 43 'Neck' and ch. 44 'Back', and Moore KL et al., Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed. Derived data (scripts/cryo/vhf_deep_neck_from_cryo.py), rule-based.

not_attempted.rectus_capitis_anterior: ~1 cm3 under the C1 lateral mass: no CT label anchors it and the frame's z residual (8.9 mm rms) exceeds its size
not_attempted.semispinalis_thoracis: its T1-T6 territory is inside the erector columns' spinalis / transversospinalis labels; thin and largely tendinous at 1 mm
not_attempted.splenius_cervicis: not separable from splenius capitis (one sheet); carried in the splenius compartment

splenius_right.note: 79.0 cm3; compartment: splenius capitis + splenius cervicis, one sheet in these photographs (no septum between the capitis and its inferolateral cervicis part at 1 mm); mapped to null, candidates listed.
